where: title 'Résumé des premiers exposés de A. Grothendieck'
scan: the title is double-underlined (two parallel rules); 'Exposé I', 'rédigé par P. Deligne' and 'Sommaire' have single underlines
tex: \underline{Résumé des premiers exposés de A. Grothendieck}

fix.old: \underline{Résumé des premiers exposés de A. Grothendieck}
fix.new: \underline{\underline{Résumé des premiers exposés de A. Grothendieck}}

note: Single against double underline only. The diplomatic files have no double underline elsewhere; nested \underline is plain LaTeX.
Misspelt name in the print; the TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: end of the paragraph 'De plus, ... constructibilité générique', after f_1 : X_1 -> S
scan: les R^i f_* Z/l^n (f without the index 1)
note: The morphism was just named f_1 : X_1 -> S; the print drops the index (possibly a deliberate abuse of notation). The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: displayed congruence after 'on a pour sigma in I'
note: phi_n is the map I/P -> mu_n, so its argument is sigma, not u. Both the PDF scan and the DjVu witness read phi_n(u). The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: 0.4, 'Soient eta un point géométrique générique de S'
note: The geometric generic point is eta-bar (base point of pi_1(S-D, eta-bar) in the same paragraph). No bar in either the PDF scan or the DjVu witness, so it is not a scan loss. The TeX keeps the printed reading.
French spelling algèbres, as the print itself has on p. 5 ('V_o-algèbres voulues'). The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: convention of Exposé I; in this batch p. 4 (hat Z(1)(k(s-bar)) four times) and p. 5 (F_p five times, Q_l once)
scan: the same typewriter double-struck Z, Q, F as on pp. 2-3
note: Reported once as a convention: expose_I_body.tex writes the print's double-struck letters as \mathbf{Z}, \mathbf{Q}, \mathbf{F} on pp. 4-12 and 21-22, but as \mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{Q} on pp. 2-3 and 13. The print uses one double-struck glyph throughout. Replace \mathbf{Z}, \mathbf{Q}, \mathbf{F} by \mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{Q}, \mathbb{F} in the file (\mathbb is already used there).
Singular noun with plural adjectives; the TeX keeps the printed singular.

where: (0.5.3), 'On peut donc supposer les a_i . dans W(k')'
scan: a_i . dans: a small separate period after the subscript i
note: Stray period in mid-sentence. The dot is distinct from the dot of the subscript i and appears in both the PDF scan and the DjVu witness, so it belongs to the print. The TeX keeps it.

where: Proposition 1.1, 'GL(n,Q_l) . On suppose remplie la condition suivante :'
scan: the period after GL(n,Q_l) is not underlined; the underline starts at 'On'
tex: \underline{. On suppose remplie la condition suivante}
